title: BrandProfile
description: The brand profile that drives caption generation for a local service business. Vertical-agnostic by design — every field must make sense for a tuition centre today and for other local service verticals later.

business_name.description: The business's name as it should appear in captions.

vertical.description: The category of local service business, e.g. "tuition centre".

tone_descriptors.description: 3-5 adjectives describing the voice captions should be written in.

target_audience.description: A short plain-language description of who the business's captions should speak to.

value_props.description: The core reasons a customer should choose this business.

keywords.description: 5-10 words or short phrases relevant to the business's captions and hashtags.

example_phrases.description: 1-3 short phrases written in the business's own voice, used to anchor caption tone.
